items.title: Expose DONE closure runbook from existing DONE pre-check data
items.context: Add or extend a CLI surface that projects remaining closure gates between the current phase and DONE. Prefer reusing session_brief/next or existing done-oracle data over duplicating gate predicates. The surface must be read-only by default and include branch sync, delivery-check, summary, validation, bug, evidence freshness, declared artifact, and related-doc advisory state.

items.title: Separate localNonAuthorityAudit from authorityServerPath in output
items.context: The runbook must mechanically distinguish local lifecycle/DONE readiness from Authority Server receipt-backed completion. Local CLI/two-host evidence must not set or imply receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone.

items.title: Register process-fact and command contracts consistently
items.context: If adding a command or extending an existing surface, update CLI schema/registry, command policy/process-fact registry, and contract verification so the capability is classified as read-only lifecycle observability rather than gate evidence or Authority proof.

items.title: Add regression coverage for TEST PASS not equal DONE
items.context: Add focused tests proving a TEST story with passing validation but missing delivery-check/summary is reported as not DONE, local Non-authority closure cannot claim Authority fields, and Authority guidance remains receipt-backed.
